name: 46972-specoffloadreplay-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process engine, one node.
workload: long-prompt replay against a CPU offload tier, speculative decoding on. 12 unique 16384-token prefixes, each followed by 64 fresh prompt tokens, generating 32 tokens, bounded at 240 requests. Greedy sampling (temperature 0), static seed 46972. guidellm `synthetic_text`, one prefix bucket (prefix_count 12, prefix_tokens 16384), `concurrent` profile, driven in-process through the `vllm_python` backend rather than over HTTP.
purpose: An 8B document assistant answering single-stream follow-up questions on 16K-token documents with draft-accelerated short replies on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

speculative-config: {"model": "AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_eagle3", "method": "eagle3", "num_speculative_tokens": 1}

kv-transfer-config: {"kv_connector": "OffloadingConnector", "kv_role": "kv_both", "kv_connector_extra_config": {"block_size": 256, "cpu_bytes_to_use": 51539607552}}

enable-prefix-caching: false

max-num-batched-tokens: 2048

tensor-parallel-size: 1

max-model-len: 20480
